title: Redeemers and the Triage list
summary: Saving what can be saved among the supernatural.

claims.text: Redeemers work to salvage the supernatural, sorting monsters into the penitent and the unremitting.
Their slang spreads mainly on the Triage email list; beasts there means irredeemable monsters, those that seem to enjoy using their powers and feeding their hungers to cause suffering.
Redeemers form close bonds among themselves and keep their own relations with the other creeds.
